intro: Slips and trips are the most common workplace injury and a serious risk to frail people, yet almost all are preventable.
points: If someone may be injured, never lift them from the floor by hand — moving them can worsen a fracture.
Call 999 if they hit their head, take blood-thinners, may have a fracture, or you are unsure.
After a fall stay calm, don't rush to move them, check for injury and breathing, and summon help.
Clean spills immediately, use warning signs, keep walkways clear, and report failed lights or loose flooring promptly.
Falls are multifactorial, combining intrinsic and extrinsic factors; a fall in the past year is the strongest predictor of another.
Record every fall even without injury, continue post-fall observations, and encourage safe activity and strength and balance training.
